Generalized Gamma model for SAR intensities (R6)

Source: R/models.R
GGammaSAR.Rd

R6 class for the generalized Gamma law (see dggamma()). Estimation is carried out by profiling: for a given power \(\alpha\), the maximum likelihood estimates of \(\phi\) and \(\mu\) are available in closed form (up to a one-dimensional root), so the profile likelihood is maximised over \(\alpha\) only.

Examples

set.seed(1)
z <- rggamma(1000, alpha = 1.5, phi = 3, mu = 2)
m <- GGammaSAR$new()$fit(z)
m
#> <Generalized Gamma> fitted to n = 1000 observations
#>   alpha = 1.34428
#>   phi = 3.4875
#>   mu = 2.47093
#>   logLik = -458.979
#>   Shannon entropy = 0.458979
